About this item

  • Power Output: 1100VA/925W pure sine wave backup for lights, fans, mixer grinder, IT loads, WiFi router, LED TV & office setup; stable performance for sensitive electronics.
  • Inbuilt Lithium Battery: 12.8V 100Ah (1280Wh) LiFePO4 battery integrated—compact, safe, long life and reliable daily power backup.
  • Smart WiFi Monitoring: Check UPS status, battery level & alerts via WiFi (app support); ideal for home, office and shop power management.
  • Fast Charging & Low Maintenance: Zero water topping, quick recharge and hassle-free use; designed for easy everyday operation.
  • Wall Mount Design & Protection: Wall-mounted compact unit with inbuilt BMS and protections (overload/short circuit/overcharge) plus 12-year onsite warranty.

    • L.D
      5 out of 5 stars
      Compact and smart invertor with good back up time
      Reviewed in India on 12 April 2026
      Colour: White
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Compact, 20kg, Looks good and works well in both invertor and ups mode. We have been using it for a week now and never failed during switching from main to back. We are using back up for led tv, fans, few lights, refrigerator, Wi-Fi router. Overall load is between 300 watts to 550watts. Fan noise is there during charging and back up time however not so load. It depends on room size and placement may be. There is no continuous beep sound which is good. For a 400watts load it came for 2.r hrs which good enough for our need. Did not test ant max loads or high voltages. It charges at 20 amp and takes like 5 hrs for full charge which is ok for us. During last 30 minutes of charging, we hear fan on and off. We think it’s normal as it happens during every charge. It has Wi-Fi connectivity and works well for Samsung phone. FYI, as soon as you open app, it will take few secs to show the registered products. Paperless registration via app was easy also. The app has basic info like charging time, back time which is useful. The charts are not easy to understand ( at least for me). The inbuilt display sows also all important info lie load% , charging speed, output voltage, invertor or ups mode, charging time, back up time. There is a bypass switch to use during invertor failures. The service in Hyderabad is good. Got the product delivered on time and basic details explained at time of delivery.

    • Pramit
      4 out of 5 stars
      Outstanding hardware, wall-mount safety—let down by frustrating Wi-Fi setup and a basic app.
      Reviewed in India on 4 September 2026
      Colour: White
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Build & Safety: The build quality is solid, and the plug-and-play setup is completely hassle-free. The wall-hanging design is a huge advantage if you have small kids—it mounts securely out of reach, eliminates floor clutter, and hides hazardous loose cables. Its not a portable product.

      Lithium Advantage: Having an integrated lithium battery means zero maintenance—no distilled water top-ups, no acid spills, and no fumes.

      The Drawback: Connecting to Wi-Fi was frustrating and took about 7–10 days of trial and error to pair properly. The companion app also feels dated and very basic rather than futuristic.

      A reliable, compact, value for the money and safe power backup for the home—just don't buy it solely for the "smart" connectivity.

    • Saiprasad shelke
      5 out of 5 stars
      Chota packet, bada backup.
      Reviewed in India on 8 June 2026
      Colour: White
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      The Microtek i-Lithium Plus 1500 SW is a compact, plug-and-play inverter combo featuring a built-in 12.8 V 100Ah Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) battery and Pure Sine Wave output. Priced around ₹44200 after applying CC offers, it eliminates the maintenance hassles of traditional lead-acid batteries.

      Here is a quick breakdown of its performance:Key HighlightsBattery Life & Safety: Offers up to 3x longer life (approx. 10 years) compared to tubular batteries and includes a built-in Battery Management System (BMS) for safety and zero water-top-up maintenance.Performance: Provides 1150 VA capacity (925 W output), making it capable of running 3 ceiling fans, 5 LED lights, and a TV for up to 4 hours (on a moderate load).

      Charging & Display: Recharges fully in about 5 to 6 hours and features a Smart LCD display with Wi-Fi app connectivity to track battery levels and backup time remotely.

      Pros & Cons

      Pros: Compact, sleek wall-mountable design, noiseless operation, and a 5-year on-site warranty on both the unit and the battery.

      Cons: It utilizes a transformer-based design, and users have reported a faint hum while the battery is actively charging.

      With so many Pros over cons this is a master piece that can fullfill your needs in a small place.

      excellent product,

      Though it’s a new technology in market but as company claims 5 year on site warranty is make it super deal,

      1) shape and wall mount is super and it has 8 inch thickness includes bracket and product it self just 6 inch thicker,

      2) easy app connectivity where you can easily check how long it will last though it’s not accurate you will know how long it’s going to run,

      3) it has 2 fan which makes it long lasting it runs while charging and using the product during power outage to control product temperature,

      4) it runs my house 3 fan and 3 22w light, i connected with my wifi as well for atleast 3 and half hours.

      5) it delivers seamless switching like i did not even notice power outage it immediately switch on inverter,

      cons,

      1) no major cons i observed but it’s 2 fan which makes little noise so do not recommend to install inside house, i have my small office inside house where i installed, but those 2 fans are supup they control temperature of product excellently and those are the plus point which i guess increase product lifespan.

      This is the best inverter. no leakage, no problems, easy to use, easy to handle, and easy to install. My husband installed it himself without any issues.

      When we first received our lithium inverter, it arrived slightly broken on the side, so it wasn’t working. We returned it and received a replacement, which has been working great.

      The features are excellent, and the inverter can also be monitored through the mobile app. If my husband is away from home, he can easily check the inverter from his phone, which is a great feature.

      We did a lot of research before choosing this inverter, and I’m really happy with our decision. If you’re reading my review, just go for it!

      The display is great, the battery life is excellent, and we’ve been using it for three months now. Since installing it, we’ve basically forgotten about it because it works so well.

      The size is compact and space-saving, which is another big plus for us. Overall, we’re very happy with this inverter and would definitely recommend it.

    About this Item

    • Power Output: 1100VA/925W pure sine wave backup for lights, fans, mixer grinder, IT loads, WiFi router, LED TV & office setup; stable performance for sensitive electronics.
    • Inbuilt Lithium Battery: 12.8V 100Ah (1280Wh) LiFePO4 battery integrated—compact, safe, long life and reliable daily power backup.
    • Smart WiFi Monitoring: Check UPS status, battery level & alerts via WiFi (app support); ideal for home, office and shop power management.
    • Fast Charging & Low Maintenance: Zero water topping, quick recharge and hassle-free use; designed for easy everyday operation.
    • Wall Mount Design & Protection: Wall-mounted compact unit with inbuilt BMS and protections (overload/short circuit/overcharge) plus 5-year onsite warranty.

    Product description

    Power your home and workspace with the advanced Microtek I-Lithium Plus WiFi 1500 SW, a smart wall-mounted inverter with an integrated lithium battery system. Designed for modern homes, offices, and shops, this compact energy solution delivers reliable 1100VA / 925W pure sine wave output, ensuring safe operation of sensitive appliances like LED TVs, routers, laptops, fans, and lights.
